subject: Upcoming Job Interview Schedule
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to inform you that we have scheduled your job interview for the Marketing Assistant position on Friday, 15th October at 10:00 AM. The interview will be conducted at our office located at 123 Main Street. Please confirm your attendance by replying to this email. We look forward to meeting you and discussing your qualifications further. Best regards, [Your Name]
